# BDPM fixtures

Excerpt of `CIS_RCP.csv` from the French public drug database
(BDPM, ANSM), snapshot of 2022-04-15.
Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0 (Etalab).

Rows are selected by `scripts/extract_bdpm_fixtures.py` to cover parsing
edge cases (modern and legacy anchors, sub-anchors, misplaced anchor,
missing posology, empty row). Content is unmodified.
